method.band: projected identity-ring triangles (pixel centres), from createWorldFor + identityMarkerGeometry/RingGeometry + fitCameraToArea at the measured canvas size; pixels inside painted HUD boxes excluded
method.changedSubset: band pixels whose RGB differs between the Classic and High contrast arms of the same mode
method.toneMapped: per tank: F = (Classic measured median - 0.85 * T(authored Classic)) / 0.15, T = three r186 ACES (exposure 1.35) + sRGB OETF; references = 0.85 * T(candidate) + 0.15 * F; nearest under CIEDE2000
method.measuredOffset: per tank: offset = median Classic-arm colour of its changed band pixels - its authored Classic colour (per sRGB channel); every candidate colour + that offset (clamped) is a reference; nearest reference under CIEDE2000 (colour-distance.ts distance)
method.candidates: FFA: the 4 ring colours of each palette (8). Teams: the 3 team colours of each palette (6).
